name: Alma Briolde
source:
Since moving to Tarn as a teenager, Alma has never truly thought of the Mosaic as her home. She helped establish the Lamplight long before inheriting it from her father, serving cheer and world-class cooking to guests who regaled her with tales of adventure.

Of course, cheer was easier when the business still brought in money. These days, despite what she may claim, Alma runs a charity for the forcibly-retired treasure hunters she can't bear to turn her back on.

(in-game profile)
